topic: The best free AI tools right now, one per job: chat, research, writing, slides, images, transcription and coding, with what each free plan really includes and where it stops
audience: Professionals and beginners who want to use AI at work without paying yet, and want to know what each free plan really allows
goal: Pick one free tool per job, sign up for the two or three they need this week, and know the limits of each free plan before they hit them
notes: ChatGPT's plans are Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise. [https://chatgpt.com/pricing/]
ChatGPT Free advertises 'Unlimited text chats with GPT-6', subject to abuse guardrails. [https://chatgpt.com/pricing/]
Besides unlimited text chats, ChatGPT Free lists only limited uploads, image creation, voice chats, deep research, and memory and context. [https://chatgpt.com/pricing/]
ChatGPT's published context window on Free is 27K tokens for GPT Instant (54K on Go and Plus, 128K on Pro). [https://chatgpt.com/pricing/]

OpenAI says ads may appear in ChatGPT for Free and Go users (testing began in the US on February 9, 2026); Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise and Edu have no ads. [https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001047-ads-in-chatgpt]
In ChatGPT's plan table, image generation is Limited on Free; data analysis is Limited on Free; Search is on every plan. [https://chatgpt.com/pricing/]
ChatGPT's Images page says you can start generating images for free with a ChatGPT account; you must log in or sign up to create images. [https://chatgpt.com/images/]

ChatGPT data analysis accepts spreadsheets (.xls, .xlsx, .csv), PDFs and text/data files, and for some tasks writes and runs Python. [https://help.openai.com/en/articles/8437071-data-analysis-with-chatgpt]

Claude's Free plan costs $0 and includes limited usage every 5 hours and every week, chat on web/desktop/mobile, web search, file creation and code, memory, connectors, Artifacts, and Claude Design, Slides and Docs. [https://claude.com/pricing]
On Claude's Free plan, a session-based usage limit resets every five hours and the number of messages varies with demand. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8114491-get-started-with-claude]
On Claude's Free plan the comparison table shows Sonnet and Haiku as available, but not Opus or Fable. [https://claude.com/pricing]

In Claude Desktop, chat is available on every plan including Free, while Claude Code and Claude Cowork require Pro, Max, Ultra, Team or Enterprise. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/10065433-install-claude-desktop]
Claude Code is included in all paid plans and shares the plan's usage limits with chat. [https://claude.com/pricing]
Free Claude users can create up to five projects. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/9517075-what-are-projects]

Claude can create Excel, PowerPoint, Word and PDF files in a conversation; code execution and file creation is available to all users, Free through Enterprise, and is on by default for Free. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12111783-create-and-edit-files-with-claude]

For artifacts made from a template, 'Export' sends docs to Word, PDF, Markdown or Google Docs, and decks to PowerPoint or PDF, or straight to Google Slides. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/17153992-what-are-artifacts-and-how-do-i-use-them]

In the Claude help-center sharing table, 'Share with anyone who has the link' is ticked for Pro, Max, Ultra, Team and Enterprise but not Free. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/9547008-share-artifacts]
Claude for PowerPoint, the PowerPoint add-in, is available to Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise plans (not Free). [https://claude.com/docs/office-agents/powerpoint]
Anthropic committed on February 4, 2026 that Claude will remain ad-free, with no sponsored links and no advertiser influence on responses. [https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-is-a-space-to-think]
Free, Pro, Max and Ultra Claude plans list model training as opt-out. [https://claude.com/pricing]

Claude can draw custom diagrams, charts and interactive visuals inline in a chat; the feature is in beta for all Claude users on web and desktop and does not render in the iOS or Android apps. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13979539-custom-visuals-in-chat-and-cowork]
Anthropic says Claude does not generate photos or illustrations. [https://chatgpt.com/pricing/]

Perplexity's individual plans are Standard (Free), Perplexity Pro, Perplexity Max and Education Pro. [https://www.perplexity.ai/help-center/en/articles/11187416-which-perplexity-subscription-plan-is-right-for-you]

Perplexity Free gives practically unlimited basic searches, 3 Pro Searches a day, 1 Research query a month and limited file uploads, with no advanced AI models or image generation. [https://www.perplexity.ai/help-center/en/articles/11187416-which-perplexity-subscription-plan-is-right-for-you]

Gemini Free costs $0 a month with a Google Account and includes image generation and editing, Deep Research, Gemini Live, Canvas, Gemini Notebook and 15 GB of storage (US page). [https://gemini.google/subscriptions/]
Google AI Plus gives 2x higher usage than Free; Google AI Pro gives 4x higher usage than Free. [https://gemini.google/subscriptions/]

Gemini Notebook (Google's new name on the NotebookLM plans page) is in Google's Free plan as a 'Research and writing assistant'; paid plans add more Audio Overviews and notebooks. [https://gemini.google/subscriptions/]

In the Gemini app, the Nano Banana 2 image model (generation and editing, 2K resolution) is free; Nano Banana 2.1, Google's best image model, needs a Google AI plan, which also gives higher image limits. [https://gemini.google/overview/image-generation/]
To make an image in Gemini, select 'Create images' from the tools menu, then add a prompt or upload an image to edit. [https://gemini.google/overview/image-generation/]

Gemini images carry an invisible SynthID watermark and a visible watermark; you can upload an image to the Gemini app and ask whether Google AI made it. [https://gemini.google/overview/image-generation/]

Gemini image generation is available in all languages and countries where the Gemini app is available, and it can place clear text in images in many languages. [https://gemini.google/overview/image-generation/]

Microsoft offers a limited free version of Copilot, subject to available capacity and limits; when you hit a limit you can upgrade or come back later. [https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/copilot/pricing/individuals]
Gamma's plans are Free, Plus, Pro, Ultra and Business. [https://help.gamma.app/en/articles/8077107-how-can-i-upgrade-my-gamma-subscription]

Gamma Free includes AI creations, the AI Agent, basic image models, up to 10 slides per prompt and 50k input tokens; free credits don't refresh, but you earn 200 per referral and can hold up to 2,000. [https://help.gamma.app/en/articles/8077107-how-can-i-upgrade-my-gamma-subscription]

Gamma Plus removes the 'Made with Gamma' badge from shared or exported content and allows up to 100 slides per prompt. [https://help.gamma.app/en/articles/8077107-how-can-i-upgrade-my-gamma-subscription]
In Gamma, all AI actions (presentations, images, AI-agent edits) use credits. [https://help.gamma.app/en/articles/8077107-how-can-i-upgrade-my-gamma-subscription]

Otter.ai's Basic plan is free: 300 monthly transcription minutes (no rollover), up to 30 minutes per conversation, 3 lifetime audio/video file imports, live transcription and speaker identification. [https://otter.ai/pricing]
Otter Basic works with Zoom, MS Teams and Google Meet, includes AI Chat within and across meetings and multi-language support, and has iOS and Android apps. [https://otter.ai/pricing]
Otter Pro gives 1,200 minutes a month and up to 90 minutes per meeting. [https://otter.ai/pricing]

GitHub Copilot Free includes limited access to a selection of Copilot features so you can try AI coding assistance at no cost; all plans include Copilot CLI and the Copilot app. [https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/get-started/plans]

Copilot Free: an allowance of GitHub AI Credits, inline code suggestions limited to 2,000 completions a month, Copilot Chat in IDEs, inline chat, slash commands and Copilot Chat in GitHub Mobile, and models through auto model selection only. [https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/get-started/plans]

Copilot Free is only for individual developers who don't have Copilot through an organization or enterprise; verified students can get Copilot Student for free; Copilot Pro is $10 USD a month. [https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/get-started/plans]
Prices and plan details are US pages read on 27 November 2026; local prices and features vary by country. [https://gemini.google/subscriptions/]
